purpose: END-TO-END confirmation of R1 (root anchoring) for the AC2 live probe.
why_here: The probe's evidence is its SURVIVAL, so its path must be one the two competing interpretations of a CONFIGURED pattern DISAGREE about. This path IS matched by '**/docs/reports/*-artifacts/**/*.json' (the INCORRECT '**/'-prefixed reading) and is NOT matched by 'docs/reports/*-artifacts/**/*.json' (the CORRECT root-anchored reading, which roborev v0.61.2's git.FormatExcludeArgs applies to any pattern containing an interior '/'). It therefore survives IF AND ONLY IF R1 holds. Verified with the guard's OWN port (roborev_format_exclude_args plus the same 'git diff --name-only -- <exclude pathspecs>' survivor query), in BOTH directions, against controls that must be EXCLUDED (docs/reports/3229-artifacts/*.json, under the repository's own root docs/) and must SURVIVE (scripts/flow/*.sh).
history: Round 9 RELOCATED this probe. It previously sat at 'website/src/content/docs/_3229-root-anchoring-probe.json', where it discriminated against the pre-round-6 pattern 'docs/**/*.json'. Round 6's directory-scoping (7a) REMOVED that pattern, and no remaining configured pattern matched the old path under EITHER interpretation — so it survived both and proved nothing. A probe that survives unconditionally is vacuous evidence, not weak evidence.
expected: present in the prompt actually sent
if_absent: the recovered algorithm is FALSIFIED — a BLOCKING finding, not an acceptable recorded outcome; the pattern list in .roborev.toml and the ported construction in scripts/flow/roborev-review-oracles.sh both depend on R1
leading_underscore: BOTH the containing directory ('_3229-artifacts') and this file are underscore-prefixed, so Astro's content-collection glob ignores the whole subtree and it is inert to the website build. The directory ALSO has to match '*-artifacts' for the probe to discriminate, and '_3229-artifacts' does.
check: There is deliberately NO script to run: this change REMOVED docs/reports/3229-artifacts/probe-census-exclusion.sh, because a committed executable under the repository's own root docs/ is swallowed by 'docs/**' and would make census-exclusion FAIL permanently until this change merges (a deadlock, not a test). Check this file by hand against a live review: `roborev show <job> --prompt | grep -F 'website/src/content/docs/reports/_3229-artifacts/_3229-root-anchoring-probe.json'` MUST print the path. Full procedure, prerequisites and recording obligation: docs/reports/3229-artifacts/live-probe-procedure.md
